description_en: Modifies the name, description, or retention period of a snapshot
description_zh: 修改一份快照的名称、描述或保留天数
name: ModifySnapshotAttribute

parameters.help_en: The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). To prevent name conflicts with automatic snapshots, the name cannot start with auto
parameters.help_zh:
快照的显示名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

为防止和自动快照的名称冲突，不能以auto开头
parameters.name: snapshot_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the snapshot. The description can be empty and can be up to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 快照的描述。可为空，长度为最大256 个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to shutdown the instant access feature for the snapshot. Valid values:
true: shutdown the instant access feature.
false: do not shutdown the instant access feature.
Default value: false.

[Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated. Standard snapshots of ESSD cloud disks have been upgraded to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193667.html. You do not need to perform additional configurations, and no additional fees are incurred
parameters.help_zh:
关闭快照极速可用功能。取值范围：

true：关闭快照极速可用。
false：不关闭快照极速可用。

默认值：false。

该参数已弃用。ESSD云盘标准快照已升级为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193667.html，您无需额外配置，且不产生额外花销
parameters.name: disable_instant_access

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of the snapshot in days. When you specify this parameter, the retention period is calculated from the creation time of the snapshot. The creation time is represented in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and displayed in UTC. Valid values: 1 to 65536.
You can only extend the retention period of a snapshot. You cannot shorten the existing retention period
parameters.help_zh:
快照保留天数。设置该值时，快照保留时间会从快照创建时间(按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ)开始计算。取值范围：1~65536。

快照保留时间仅支持延长，不支持缩短快照已有保留时间
parameters.name: retention_days
